recorder_not_excluded.title: Effy entities are not excluded from the recorder
recorder_not_excluded.description:
Effy writes 5-minute statistics for its `sensor.effy_*` entities directly into the recorder database. Home Assistant's own recorder also tries to compile statistics for these entities automatically, because they are still tracked like ordinary sensors — the two can write to the same slot at the same time and occasionally fail with a database error (`UNIQUE constraint failed: statistics_short_term...`).

To fix this, add the following to your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
recorder:
  exclude:
    entity_globs:
      - sensor.effy_*
```

This only stops Home Assistant's own recorder from separately tracking these entities — Effy's own statistics writes are unaffected and continue to populate history/energy-dashboard graphs normally.
